name: desktop-nav-responsive-rail
goal: Keep tablet navigation on one scrolling row with a clean context rail and aligned Game Views icon

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual5 rejects tablet context placement, ragged wrapped tabs and the missing Game Views icon; mobile must retain aligned readable icon labels.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog cases checked Settings visibility but not tab row geometry, context alignment or the Game Views SVG. Add those assertions to the same cases and scroll the game link into view through the standard action.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint ec8a9f1cf0 records three failures and one mobile default pass. Record79a952e83aaac5ef6c99a097d7c21031361cd1ac54e1989744c09dc2e94e051c retains four before images; tablet tabs wrap and Game Views has no SVG.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
